title: NOTCURSES III: THE SAGA CONTINUES (1080P)
summary: A seven-minute demo from the author of Notcurses, a C library for text user interfaces. It shows the 2.3.0 release, which adds Sixel and Kitty bitmap graphics integrated into its multiplane character-graphics model.
why: HN people share it as a striking demonstration of how much graphics a modern terminal can do.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: the WTF effect that video had on me lasted quite a while.
